notes.notes:
[h1]UI[/h1]
The entire interface has been reworked. Now it is suitable for non-widescreen monitors.

Added button TAB with which you can see what you need to do on a mission

notes.title: Leaderboard
notes.notes:
Leaderboard is entered for the competition of users in the number of killed enemies, the data is stored on the server and will not be deleted in case of reinstalling the Wins or deleting the save files.

notes.title: Development Diary 3 Two Level
notes.notes:
The first level two development.

The camera moved and you watched the whole side. From TPS, the game turned into Side Scroller.

It was decided to give up, it changed the whole spirit of the game, so now you need to kill at the second level more than [b]10k enemies[/b] to finish it.

And it could have been otherwise.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32474008/417f0df332c3d2581dba5b4fae89c47e8ba1c218.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32474008/f6c3963655737c65c66a6ca3b2ee2cf14c247bc3.png[/img]

notes.title: Development Diary 2 Third Level
notes.notes:
[h1]Third level.[/h1]

One of the variations of the third level.
The purpose of this mission was to stay on a constantly moving platform and jump over obstacles, but tests showed that it's [b]VERY[/b] boring.

The level was endless, but due to lack of experience, it turned out that it had to be altered and now you can evaluate how the machine [b]FLOWs[/b] to heaven due to uneven surfaces on a new [b]THIRD LEVEL[/b].
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32474008/6c032f8f516f65b76a33dd5153e227d7391488ca.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32474008/7ac071fbbcf1219b595bd3f6ef03a05a1a759f51.png[/img]

notes.title: Development Diary
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello everybody![/h1]
I want to show how the development went and what the game looked like at an early stage.

The screenshot shows an option with [b]VERY[/b] bright tracers from the shots, but a few tests later it turned out that you could be sick. I had to give it up.

Just had to abandon the detached parts of the body in favor of the animation of death. Very heavily loaded CPU.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32474008/5fc769aea561388c1b819a051ba08a1a678e2772.png[/img]
